method: bounded read-only authenticated Partnerize campaign, participation, and effective-terms endpoints

observed_rules: Only content and images supplied by P1 may be used; P1 website content may not be copied without permission.
The product feed for the matching country domain controls which events may be promoted.
Country-specific exclusions override the general COM feed.
P1 promotion through the UK site is prohibited.
Search advertising, social-media advertising, and retargeting are prohibited.
Each email newsletter requires prior P1 affiliate-team approval; organic social posts require preview before publication.
Excluded software, incentive, pop-up, and pop-under traffic requires explicit consent.

remaining_unknowns: Explicit permission to ingest and republish feed-derived data for ticket comparison
Complete attribution and deduplication mechanics beyond the published restrictions
Current operational contact and renewal/change-notice mechanics
How the publisher can request regeneration of dead feeds
interpretation: Current terms materially constrain content, geography, traffic, and channel use. They make the locale product feed operationally authoritative, but the feeds are unavailable and comparison-site ingestion permission is not explicit. PLT-057 remains open.
